📗 Day 2 — Strings Practice

Strings • Manipulation • VSCode • LeetCode

TASK-1

🔤 Step 1 • Learn String Basics

Recommended: Python

Python String Documentation

Understand indexing, slicing, concatenation, immutability, loops and string methods.

💻 Step 2 • Explore Strings in VS Code

  • ✂️ String slicing
  • 🔍 Character access
  • 🔁 Loops on strings
  • 🔡 upper(), lower()
  • 🧹 strip(), replace()
  • 🪄 split(), join()
  • 📏 len()
  • 🔄 reverse using slicing

🧩 Step 3 • Beginner String Questions

  1. Create the string "Programming". Print the first, middle and last character.
  2. Create "OpenAI". Convert it to uppercase and lowercase.
  3. Count how many vowels exist inside "Mississippi".
  4. Reverse the string "Artificial Intelligence".
  5. Check whether "python" exists inside "I love python programming".
  6. Replace every space inside "Data Structures and Algorithms" with "-".
  7. Split "apple,mango,banana,grapes" into a list.
  8. Join ["AI","ML","DL"] into a single string using commas.

🔥 Step 4 • LeetCode Practice

  • 344. Reverse String
  • 125. Valid Palindrome
  • 58. Length of Last Word
  • 14. Longest Common Prefix
  • 28. Find the Index of First Occurrence in a String
⚠️ Focus on indexing, slicing and traversal patterns before optimization.
